60 Cross-cutting (authentication, authorization, platform services)

Concerns shared by many features: sign-in, access control, service-to-service calls, storage, messaging, logging, cache, configuration.

X-01 Admin login (phone OTP + password)Three-step admin sign-in: phone, SMS OTP, Cognito password. X-02 Admin forgot passwordReset an admin password after an SMS OTP. X-03 Admin change password and logoutChange the password in Cognito; sign out and clear local state. X-04 Admin session handling (token attach and refresh)How the admin portal attaches, caches and refreshes tokens. X-05 Staff account provisioningHow admin, checker and agent accounts are created in Cognito by the Admin service. X-06 Customer registrationSign-up with email and phone OTP, then password; OneID alternative. X-07 Customer login with phone and passwordUser-pool sign-in in portal and app. X-08 OneID single sign-onSign in through OneID federated by Cognito; auto-register on first login. X-09 Customer forgot/reset passwordOTP-based password reset through the identity API. X-10 Customer change password, logout and token attachSession handling in portal and app. X-11 Delete account and app force-updateApp-only account deletion and the minimum-version gate. X-12 Checker loginTicketChecker-pool sign-in in the checker app. X-13 Agent pool and offline-sold ticketsAgent accounts and the only Agent API. X-14 Authorization layer 1: pool schemes and policiesWhich Cognito pool a token must come from, per endpoint. X-15 Authorization layers 2–3: staff rolescustom:role → role claims and [Authorize(Roles=…)]; role × endpoint matrix. X-16 Authorization layer 4: program scopeX-Program-Id, custom:program_ids, [AuthorizeProgram] and the EF query filter. X-17 Client-side authorization (menus and guards)What the portals hide or block per role; not a security boundary. X-18 Endpoints without authorizationEvery endpoint reachable without a token, and why. X-19 Service-to-service communicationTyped HTTP clients with token forwarding, tokenless worker calls, and SQS. X-20 File storage (S3, CloudFront)Media and ticket buckets, folder layout, signed URLs and cookies. X-21 Email (SES)Where the platform sends email. X-22 SMS and the external notification serviceSMS/OTP and notification calls to services outside the repos. X-23 Push notifications (PushNotification service, Firebase)Device tokens, send APIs, queue and FCM. X-24 Activity logging (audit trail)How entity changes are recorded across services. X-25 Redis: cache, live capacity and locksKey families, cache usage and RedLock distributed locks. X-26 Configuration and secretsWhere settings come from in AWS and locally; key reference.
